bio: Darcy is a London-based Graphic Designer, specialising in branding, advertising, and editorial design, as well as web design and illustration and print design. By merging digital expertise with a foundational approach to visual storytelling, Darcy creates cohesive, research-driven outcomes tailored to the contemporary landscape. She has gained industry experience through spending time with DrMartens and Peter Holmes Creative Imaging. Darcy is a dedicated and proactive designer who excels in collaborative environments, viewing every brief as an opportunity to tackle creative challenges and turn ideas into a visual story.

projects.title: The Algorithmic Edit
projects.description: The Algorithmic Edit is an exploration of what happens when we swap human intuition for machine logic. In this project, metadata isn't just a background tool, it’s the main driver of the design. I wanted to see if I could replace my own "designer’s voice" with the cold logic of a system, using data to dictate the structure of the work rather than just my own feeling.
